[Fact w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-2 {"project":"docs"}) The docs project's agenium.toml has an empty [checks] pre_merge value, so merge-time content rules must be inferred from the README and existing files rather than from the config.
[Fact w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-2 {"project":"docs"}) The docs project repo root contains README.md, agenium.toml, deliverables/, notes/ and artifacts/; reports/ is added when a ticket needs it.

[Lesson w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) Before writing a file in the docs project, read the existing file and search the repo for required header patterns, since the project's merge checks may not be visible in agenium.toml.

[Lesson w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) When creating or adding any team document or file under deliverables/ or reports/ in the docs project, write 'Owner: docs-team' as the first line before the actual content or submitting—even if acceptance criteria only mention content—otherwise the pre-merge check rejects the change/merge.
[Fact w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) The docs project README states that team documents live in deliverables/ and reports/.
[Fact w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) The docs project's pre-merge check fails any file in deliverables/ or reports/ whose first line is not exactly 'Owner: docs-team'.
[Fact w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) In the docs project, every team document in deliverables/ or reports/ must name its owning team on its first line exactly as 'Owner: docs-team'.
